swim-spas.name: Swim spas
swim-spas.title: Swim, move and soak at home, all year.
swim-spas.believe: Swim spas are for people who want to move every day without driving to a pool. Swimmers who are tired of lane schedules, families who want a pool the kids can use 12 months a year, even through a Canadian winter, and anyone who wants low-impact exercise and a hot soak afterwards, in their own backyard.
moments: Swim against the current before work. No pool schedule, no drive, no lanes to share.
The kids splash in the swim end while you soak in the seats. It's a pool and a hot tub in one.
Steam rising off the water, snow on the cover, and a warm swim when every outdoor pool in North Grenville is closed.
swim-spas.meta: Platinum Spas swim spas in Kemptville. River jet and 16-speed turbine models for swimming, fitness and family time. Text Blaine for your price.
swim-spas.help: Not sure between a river jet and a turbine, or whether you need a split-temperature model? Tell Blaine how you'll use it and he'll tell you straight which one fits.

mini-pools.name: Mini pools
mini-pools.title: A pool built into your backyard.
mini-pools.believe: Mini pools are made to be fully sunk into the ground. There's no cabinet and no siding, because they're designed to be built seamlessly into your landscaping, with your patio stone, decking or lawn running right to the edge. You get the look of an in-ground pool in a size that fits a yard a full pool never would, heated for year-round use, with a current to swim against.
moments: No box sitting on a pad. Just water, set into the patio you chose, like it was always there.
Swim against the current, then float while the kids play. It's a pool, not a hot tub.
A heated swim before work, even when there's snow on the stone around it.
mini-pools.meta: Platinum Spas mini pools in Kemptville. Fully in-ground, no siding, built into your landscaping, with river jet or turbine swim currents. Text Blaine for your price.
mini-pools.help: A mini pool is a landscaping project as much as a pool. Text Blaine and he'll walk your yard with you, so the pool, the stone and the steps all come together.

river.name: River jet
river.short: Strong jets push a current you swim against. They double as massage jets for the cool-down, and they suit people who want a swim and a soak.
river.short_pool: Strong jets push a smooth, adjustable current you swim against. Good for light swimming, resistance work and hydrotherapy, at a lower price than the turbine.

turbine.name: 16-speed turbine
turbine.short: A belt-driven turbine pulls a wide, smooth current across the whole lane, with no bubbles or turbulence. Sixteen speeds run from gentle to hard training. It's the choice for serious swimmers.
turbine.short_pool: A belt-driven turbine pulls a wide, smooth current across the whole lane, with no bubbles or turbulence. Sixteen speeds run from gentle to hard training. It's the choice for serious swimmers.
